ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is a “certain light rail section map.” According to the graphic and textual materials and relevant knowledge, what is the main purpose of the light rail in the figure adopting an elevated form? <image1>
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows the light rail line set up on an elevated bridge, passing through an urban area, with dense buildings, ground roads, and other urban activity spaces around it; the tracks and ground traffic and pedestrian activity areas are arranged in upper and lower layers. From this it is inferred that the light rail adopting an elevated form can make the train running line reduce or avoid at-grade intersections with ground motor vehicles and pedestrians, reduce traffic conflicts and accident risks, and reduce mutual interference. Therefore its main purpose is to ensure train operation safety.

method.method_draft: 读取题干询问“轻轨采用高架方式的主要目的”。先描述图像中轻轨高架穿越城区、与地面道路和建筑活动区分层布置。再结合城市交通知识：高架化使列车与地面机动车、行人互不交叉，避免事故和干扰。因此主要目的是保证行车安全。
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示轻轨线路架设在高架桥上，穿越城区，周围有密集建筑、地面道路和其他城市活动空间；轨道与地面交通、行人活动区呈上下分层布置。由此推理，轻轨采用高架方式可以使列车运行线路与地面机动车、行人减少或避免平面交叉，降低交通冲突和事故风险，减少相互干扰。因此其主要目的是保证行车安全。
